title: Praxera 404 page serves the legacy DaVinci Laboratories template (logo, nav, shop links)
where: www.praxerasupplements.com system 404 template (portal 4087538). Reproduce at https://www.praxerasupplements.com/this-page-does-not-exist-qa3 or any bad URL
evidence: curl -L of https://www.praxerasupplements.com/this-page-does-not-exist-qa3 and .../blog/nope-qa3 both return HTTP 404 with a 41KB body built on template 'DaVinciLabs_February2018'. The body contains , the footer string 'DaVinci Laboratories of Vermont (c) 2017', http://www.facebook.com/DaVinciLabs, and 57 distinct www.davincilabs.com links including a full ecommerce catalog (index.php?l=product_list&c=*, index.php?l=page_view&p=buy, index.php?l=page_view&p=where_to_buy) plus https://www.davincilabs.com/White_Paper/PROTOCOL_GUIDE_V2.pdf. proposed_fix: Set the Praxera domain's 404 (and 500) template in HubSpot Settings > Website > Pages > System pages to the Praxera theme's system template, then unpublish/re-point the DaVinciLabs_February2018 system template for www.praxerasupplements.com. Do not touch the template on davincilabs.com domains.

title: HubSpot forms do not render from a local file - form visuals verified by definition + live render endpoint instead
where: All 10 screenshotted Praxera pages
evidence: Every Praxera page loads its form via <script src="/_hcms/forms/v2.js"> + hbspt.forms.create({portalId:'4087538', formId:'...', formsBaseUrl:'/_hcms/forms/'}), so no form markup exists in the served HTML and nothing renders from file://. Workaround used: (1) confirmed each embed's form_id and redirect config in the page source, (2) curl'd https://forms.hsforms.com/embed/v3/form/4087538/{guid}/json for all 12 Praxera form GUIDs - ALL 12 returned HTTP 200 with a complete field/consent/submitText definition, so every GUID resolves live, (3) rebuilt each form's real fields, labels, consent text and submit button from that JSON and injected it into the localized page before screenshotting, so the screenshots show the true field list and button text. The form STYLING in the screenshots is approximate (HubSpot's own form CSS is applied at runtime); the field list, labels, order, consent text and button text are exact. Layout of everything outside the form is the real page with its real stylesheets and real logo.
proposed_fix: No action - methodology note.
